ProductsPage.metaDescription: Corporate fleet solutions: long-term rental, flexible fleet, electric fleet and managed fleet.
ProductsPage.title: Our fleet solutions
ProductsPage.intro: Four solutions for the pace of your business. If you are not sure which fits, our corporate team will point you in the right direction.
ProductsPage.ctaTitle: Get a quote for this solution
ProductsPage.ctaText: Share your fleet size and the period, and our corporate team will return with a tailored quote.

uzun-donem.title: Long-Term Fleet Rental
uzun-donem.summary: A fixed monthly fee on contracts of 12 months or more. Maintenance, insurance and a replacement car included; renew your fleet without tying up capital.
uzun-donem.description: Instead of buying cars you rent them for the length of the contract. The monthly fee is fixed, Novera takes care of maintenance and repairs, and the cars are renewed when the contract ends.
features: Fixed monthly fee, no surprise costs
uzun-donem.idealFor: Companies whose car needs are predictable and who plan their budget yearly.

esnek-filo.title: Flexible Fleet
esnek-filo.summary: Weekly and monthly rental for seasonal or project-based needs. Scale the number of cars up or down as you need.
esnek-filo.description: Grow your fleet for a season, a campaign or a project and shrink it when the work ends. Commitments are short and you choose the hand-over and return location.
features: Change the number of cars during the period
Hand-over and return in a different city
esnek-filo.idealFor: Companies with seasonal peaks or a field team that grows temporarily.

elektrikli.title: Electric and Hybrid Fleet
elektrikli.summary: Electric and hybrid cars that lower your carbon footprint. A charging solution and an emissions report are part of the service.
elektrikli.description: Move part or all of your fleet to electric and hybrid cars. We plan the charging and report your yearly emissions savings.
elektrikli.idealFor: Companies with a sustainability target and corporate reporting.

yonetilen-filo.title: Managed Fleet
yonetilen-filo.summary: The cars stay with you, the management is ours. Maintenance tracking, fines and fuel management and driver administration with one invoice and one contact.
yonetilen-filo.description: We take over the operational load of your existing fleet: service appointments, fines and tolls, fuel reports and driver administration are tracked from one panel.
yonetilen-filo.idealFor: Companies that own their cars but have no time for fleet management.

ServicesPage.metaDescription: Road Assurance, live tracking, digital damage reports and flexible hand-over: Novera Mobility services.
ServicesPage.title: Our Services
ServicesPage.intro: Beyond renting a car: we stand by you on the road, across the fleet and at your desk.

items.title: Road Assurance
items.summary: Ask for help with one tap if you are stranded. A 24/7 operations desk calls you back, the nearest tow truck is dispatched, and if a breakdown lasts over 24 hours a replacement car comes to your door.

items.title: Live Tracking
items.summary: The position and status of every car in the fleet is followed in real time through GPS and telematics. Routes, usage and maintenance needs appear on one screen.

items.title: Novera Driver App
items.summary: Drivers complete hand-over, fuel level and the damage report from their phone. A digital report with photos removes the paperwork and the waiting.

items.title: Novera Admin Panel
items.summary: Fleet managers handle cars, drivers, bookings and invoices from one panel, and follow cost and usage through reports.

items.title: Flexible Pick-up and Return
items.summary: Collect the car where you are and leave it in another city. You choose the pick-up and return location, date and time while booking.

ServicesPage.ctaTitle: A solution made for your fleet
ServicesPage.ctaText: Tell us what you need and our corporate team will come back with a quote.
